defs.def: a meal at which people serve themselves from a table and then stand or sit somewhere else to eat 自助餐

ex.s: I wake up to the sound of the wind buffeting the cloth of my tent.
ex.t: 我在风拍打帐篷布的声音中醒来。

ex.s: I know a buffet restaurant nearby which is really nice.
ex.t: 我知道附近有一家很好的自助餐厅。

ex.s: As long as you are not afraid of heights, you will be impressed by Sky Buffet, the latest restaurant in the city centre.
ex.t: 只要你不恐高，市中心的这家最新餐厅“空中自助”定会让你印象深刻。

ex.s: Sky Buffet is considered by many locals (be) the perfect location for a special occasion.
ex.t: 许多当地人认为“空中自助”是特殊场合的完美地点（be 应填 to be）。

ex.s: Sky Buffet serves a menu full of eye-catching Asian dishes, (6) (range) from Chinese food to Japanese food.
ex.t: “空中自助”提供的菜单上满是引人注目的亚洲菜肴，（6）应填 ranging，从中餐到日料都有。

defs.def: a place, for example in a train or bus station, where you can buy food and drinks to eat or drink there, or to take away （火车）饮食柜台；（车站）快餐部

chunks.cn: 通过 天 自助餐
